videos.title: Introducing Normatec Elite Heat Legs
videos.summary: Hyperice introduces Normatec Elite Heat, combining dynamic air compression with targeted heat to help users warm up, recover, and get ready for what's next. Available now at hyperice.com.

videos.title: Introducing Nike Air Zoom Hyperslide
videos.summary: Hyperice introduces the Nike Air Zoom Hyperslide, pairing responsive Air Zoom cushioning with Hyperice heat and vibration technology to help feet relax, reset, and recover from the ground up.
